name: Gryvka, the Chain-Bound Witch
background: CR 8 boss (3,900 XP), a succubus witch who posed as a Zahret military/government official sent to watch the party. Neutral evil.

spellsPrepared.name: Chain Link (Recharge 5–6)
spellsPrepared.desc:
**Signature spell. No concentration.** Glowing chains of thought shoot out to up to **four creatures** Gryvka can see. Each makes a **DC 16 Wisdom save**; on a failure it is **Linked** for 1 minute.

**The link ends only if:** Gryvka drops to 0 HP; the Linked creature uses its action on a **DC 16 Int or Wis check** and succeeds; or it succeeds on the Wis save it repeats at the end of each of its turns.

**While Linked:**
- **Gryvka reads its mind.** At the start of each round, players with Linked characters say their plan out loud, and Gryvka hears it.
- Gryvka has advantage on attack rolls against it.
- When it takes psychic damage, every other Linked creature takes half that amount.
- **Counterplay (Mental Noise):** once per fight, a Linked creature can make a Cha (Deception) check contested by Gryvka's Wis (Insight). On a success, Gryvka believes the false plan it announced.

spellsPrepared.name: Thought Lash
spellsPrepared.desc: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +8 to hit, one target. *Hit:* 13 (3d8) psychic damage.

spellsPrepared.name: Dissonant Whispers (2/day)
spellsPrepared.desc: 2/day. DC 16 Wisdom save, 3d6 psychic and the target must use its reaction to move away; half damage on a success.

spellsPrepared.name: Misty Step (2/day)
spellsPrepared.desc: 2/day. Teleport up to 30 feet to a space she can see.

inventory.name: Hexclaw
inventory.desc:
*Melee Weapon Attack:* +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing plus 9 (2d8) psychic damage.

**Multiattack:** two Hexclaw attacks, or one Hexclaw and cast a spell.

notes:
Gryvka is a succubus witch who posed as a Zahret military/government official assigned to watch the party. **Suhayla**, goddess of knowledge and magic, grants her mind-reading power. She has possessed one of the party's friends.

**House rule:** no concentration on spells. Every duration ends only under the conditions written.

**Defenses:** resists cold, fire, lightning, poison, and bludgeoning/piercing/slashing from nonmagical attacks. Fly speed 60 ft. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 12. Speaks Common and Abyssal, with telepathy 120 ft. Spell save DC 16, spell attack +8.

**Balance:** tuned as a deadly fight for **7 level-4 PCs** together with her three charmed Zahret Soldiers (separate NPC sheets). HP 212 (25d8 + 100), so Phase 2 starts at 106.

**DM tuning:** if it's too swingy, cut Chain Link to three targets, drop Tighten the Chains, or leave out one soldier. If it's too easy, Pull the Chain the possessed friend early in Phase 2. Make Linked status clearly visible at the table, for example with a chain token by each Linked mini.

customFeatures.name: Shapechanger
customFeatures.desc: Gryvka can turn into any Small or Medium humanoid, or back into her true form. This is how she passed as a Zahret official.

customFeatures.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
customFeatures.desc: When Gryvka fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

customFeatures.name: Suhayla's Ledger
customFeatures.desc: Gryvka can't be surprised. She knows the name and surface emotion of every creature within 60 feet of her.

customFeatures.name: Draining Kiss (Action)
customFeatures.desc: Gryvka targets one **Linked** creature within 5 feet, which makes a **DC 16 Con save**. It takes 27 (5d10) psychic damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. Its HP maximum drops by the damage taken until it finishes a long rest. Gryvka regains HP equal to half the damage dealt.

customFeatures.name: Pull the Chain (Bonus Action)
customFeatures.desc: One Linked creature uses its reaction to move up to half its speed in a direction Gryvka chooses. **Or** Gryvka pulls one secret from its mind and says it aloud.

customFeatures.name: "I Knew You'd Do That." (Reaction)
customFeatures.desc: When a Linked creature attacks Gryvka or targets her with a spell, she gains +4 AC against that attack or spell, **or** she moves up to half her speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

customFeatures.name: Legendary Actions (3/round)
customFeatures.desc:
One at a time, only at the end of another creature's turn. She regains them at the start of her turn.
- **Whisper:** one Linked creature takes 7 (2d6) psychic damage.
- **Glide:** she flies up to half her fly speed (30 ft.) without provoking opportunity attacks.
- **Tighten the Chains (Costs 2):** each Linked creature makes a DC 16 Wis save. On a failure, it uses its next action to make one attack against an ally of Gryvka's choice.

customFeatures.name: Lair Action (Initiative 20)
customFeatures.desc:
On initiative count 20 (losing ties), Gryvka uses one of these. She can't use the same one two rounds in a row.
- **Echoing Chains:** every Linked creature takes 7 (2d6) psychic damage.
- **Reach for a Mind:** one creature that isn't Linked, within 60 feet of Gryvka, makes a DC 16 Wisdom save. On a failure it becomes **Linked** (same rules as Chain Link).

customFeatures.name: Phase 2: Mask Off (at 106 HP or lower)
customFeatures.desc:
The first time Gryvka drops to 106 HP or fewer:
- **Chain Link recharges** immediately.
- Her Zahret disguise peels away and shows the chains running back to the party friend she possessed.
- That friend counts as **permanently Linked** until Gryvka dies. She can use **Pull the Chain** on them to make them take one weapon attack instead of moving.
